title: Collab on game?
author: EmberGateDev
selftext: I’m looking to work on a game together as a side project to see if it’s better that I’ve been working on my own or working with someone else. Anyone interested to see how that goes

comments.author: Key-Media-6395
comments.body: i kinda want to join a game project as well, to work on as a side project, but i dont have any ideas rn.

replies.author: EmberGateDev
replies.body: What kind of games do you like?

replies.author: Key-Media-6395
replies.body: Hmm, mostly story driven games, gameplay itself is ofc, important, but i like a wide variety. I mostly play RPGs with interesting combat (like fire emblem, or undertale) and occasionally point and click horror. Or occasionally games like Civilization

replies.author: EmberGateDev
replies.body:
I play a lot of those same  
Types of games and have some experience building actually most of those. Do you want a 3d or 2d game. What types of things do you like in those games and how much time do you want to put towards building a game . A lot of those questions will answer what direction we go

replies.author: Key-Media-6395
replies.body: i've never done a 3d game actually, since i mostly use Gamemaker, but I have used Godot. I'd probably work on it like an hour a day, but unless i get really into it i already have a main project and i wouldn't want to make too large of a project, maybe a few months total. Generally, i like character interactions and easy but not too easy puzzles. i'm not a combat junky, but i do like it to not be repetitive.

replies.author: EmberGateDev
replies.body: Okay so for an hour a day a 2d game would probably be easier you said you like fire emblem would you like something like that? Are you good at writing story material?

replies.author: Key-Media-6395
replies.body: Fire emblem style game would be cool, and i write digital novels so i sure hope i am!

replies.author: EmberGateDev
replies.body: Haha you’d be much better at writing then me I’m good at getting everything out together and don’t mind working long times on things but writing the story I’m not great at. I do have a small group of testers that could even try it and give us feedback. So if you’d like to start it let me know the direction you’d like and I can get a lot of it set up and I’ll run art styles by you. I could add you on discord and show you some of the projects I’ve been working on

replies.author: Key-Media-6395
replies.body: sure, i'll DM you my discord

replies.author: EmberGateDev
replies.body: Thank you let’s see how we work together and if we both like it go from there !

comments.author: artlemaks
comments.body: This sounds interesting! Drop me a DM :)
